name: Serrekunda

queries.query: Serrekunda Serekunda official cadastral parcel map land survey GIS map Department Lands Survey Kanifing
queries.scope: Find city-bound official land registry or public parcel GIS/vector service for Serrekunda.
queries.result: The official Ministry of Lands and Government policy sources place Serrekunda in the Greater Banjul/ Kanifing context. The Auditor General reports cadastral mapping in parts of Greater Banjul but paper-based land administration and no citizen-accessible technological interface; no public city parcel vector was found.

portals.name: Department of Lands and Survey / Deeds Registry
portals.operator: Ministry of Lands, Regional Government and Religious Affairs / Registrar General’s Department
portals.observation: The Deeds Registry is established under the Lands (Registration of Deeds) Act and registers land-affecting instruments. The Auditor General’s 2024 report says cadastral mapping exists in some parts including Greater Banjul, but land documentation remains paper-based with no citizen-accessible technological interface.

portals.name: National Land Policy 2026–2035
portals.operator: Ministry of Lands, Regional Government and Religious Affairs
portals.observation: The policy frames integrated digital land registration and information systems as a modernization objective; current conditions are described as fragmented and paper-based. Serrekunda is identified as part of the Greater Banjul conurbation; exact parcel coverage is not established.

requests.observation: Official Ministry policy document; describes land-registration and digital-LIS objectives.

Official Auditor General performance audit. Its cited fieldwork reports that only some areas are cadastral mapped, names Greater Banjul, and finds no citizen-accessible digital land-record interface; this is not a current parcel API.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: The statutory Deeds Registry covers land-affecting documents nationally; an Auditor General report says cadastral mapping existed in parts of Greater Banjul, and government policy locates Serrekunda in the Greater Banjul conurbation.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: No public full parcel polygons or city-cell geometry verified. The Greater Banjul mapping statement does not establish exact coverage at the WUP point.

technicalBlocker: No anonymous complete parcel-geometry route was identified. The audit reports broader paper-based records and a KMC property database/GIS exception, but does not expose a public vector endpoint.
remainingUncertainty: The Auditor General report cites 2022 fieldwork, and current exact parcel coverage/digitization within Serrekunda remains unknown. The new national policy is forward-looking and does not show a deployed public parcel service.
nextStep: Do not query deeds, owners, or individual property records. Revisit only if the Ministry publishes a public, city-bound parcel vector service.

registryBasis: The national Auditor General reports that Kanifing Municipal Council issues official land transfers, keeps a Rates Matrix System with near-universal municipal property registration, and operates GIS with property IDs. The council explicitly lists Serekunda East, West and Central within its municipality. This is direct local registry/mapping activity, not proof of exact WUP parcel coverage or an open geometry service.
scopeLimits: Greater Banjul mapping evidence is not an exact Serrekunda municipal parcel-coverage boundary.
No owner/address/deed lookup or property-specific query was made.

rootSupplementalResearch.finding: Primary audit contains a local KMC digital property/GIS exception to the broader paper-based system; this supports local activity. No account/property records were queried.
